root_admission.decision_basis: G3/G6 improve absolute target AM but worsen target/surface and target/offtarget mean ratios; G1 ratio gains accompany absolute target decline. Test equal900mm2 4/8/12/16 physical-contact patterns with2outputs/commonreturn and one50ohm peroutput beforefanout. Report absolute mean/P10, both mean ratios, non-target distributions and all separate burden comparisons; no magnitude-only success or geometry-infeasibility claim.

spec.planned_reuse: B0 both carriers reuse actual first8 phi_surface/metal only after root-selected direct SHA/readback proof, identical physical contact mapping/material/circuit/hybridfield ABI. Fresh residual/current/power checks still run. Missing or incompatible B0 reuse is a blocker, not an automatic PDE rerun.

solver.preconditioner: diagonal h2 sum_j Qij squared Yj plus physical contact conductance; two metal diagonal sums plus1/50

provisional_field.lateral_source: SelectivityShapeBasis.java ShapeNet.field/edgeCurrent; same archive ExploreBasis.edgeCurrent sign
provisional_field.lateral_definition: Each existing +x/+y edge (a,b) contributes (phi_a-phi_b)/(2*h) to BOTH incident cells in its oriented component
provisional_field.missing_neighbor_rule: No edge means zero face contribution; wall cells retain half contribution, never a full one-sided derivative
provisional_field.conditional_scope: Continuous z conditional on the registered discrete XY graph and inherited material/contact/circuit assumptions

spec.source_convention: Exactly two outputnodes, each with one50ohm resistor BEFOREfanout. Physical pads explicitly map to output0/output1/commonGND. Active source1Vpp high-Z=.5Vpeak; other ideal output0V/50ohm; no equal branch-current assumption.
spec.power_convention: Layer powers from analytic modal boundary flux and source/contact/50ohm powers; NEVER replaced by cell-centred reconstructed|E|² sums

geometry.confounds: Equal900mm² area and commonouter17.5mm bounds; innerextent/centroid/gaps/contactcoverage change. Area-matched segmentation patterns, not isolated causal padcount.

coordinate_system.weighting: Caller-passed original fractional native ROI weights in m3; stable inverse volume ECDF

conventions.current: Derived gamma*E total current including displacement; not independent validation
conventions.modulation: Two actual distinct sinusoidal carriers only; no multi-frequency extrapolation

thresholds.high_modulation_volume: not_run; no preregistered numerical cutoffs in this provisional batch

provisional_field.lateral_source: SelectivityShapeBasis.java ShapeNet.field/edgeCurrent; same archive ExploreBasis.edgeCurrent sign
provisional_field.lateral_definition: Each existing +x/+y edge (a,b) contributes (phi_a-phi_b)/(2*h) to BOTH incident cells in its oriented component
provisional_field.missing_neighbor_rule: No edge means zero face contribution; wall cells retain half contribution, never a full one-sided derivative
provisional_field.conditional_scope: Continuous z conditional on the registered discrete XY graph and inherited material/contact/circuit assumptions

normalizations.current_definition: Sum of individual independent-output RMS magnitudes as bookkeeping, not a unique total-current physical invariant
normalizations.burden_caps_scope: Baseline numerical values only; not human safety limits

geometry.confounds: Equal900mm² area and commonouter17.5mm bounds; innerextent/centroid/gaps/contactcoverage change. Area-matched segmentation patterns, not isolated causal padcount.
